title: Garry Tan Picks Incorruptible as the Flagship Demo for His New Book-Analysis Tool
summary: Y Combinator president Garry Tan launches 'book-mirror,' an AI tool that maps a book's ideas to your own life, and uses Eric's still-unreleased Incorruptible as the inaugural example.
blockquote:
book-mirror is the flagship.

Hand it a book, get a personalized two-column analysis. Left shows the author's idea. Right maps every idea to your actual life using your own words from the brain.

Here's the example based on a yet-unreleased book by @ericries Incorruptible
